translation: Then two great roots and two small roots came out; after it finished it was already deep in the night and I lay down. I do not know how, but when I woke the next morning it was still filled up. Pulling for a long time, it was still one root, then another root, crossing down left and right; I think it entered the Renying point. The neck was already clear, but I do not know how much was still in the abdomen; if I had not pulled, I do not know how it would have made disease.
